name: Pirate Gold Corp
summary: Pirate Gold Corp, an exploration-stage company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in North America. The company explores for iron ore and antimony/gold deposits. Its flagship property is the Moosehead Gold Property located in Central Newfoundland. The company was formerly known as Sokoman Iron Corp. and changed its name to Pirate Gold Corp in February 2019. Pirate Gold Corp is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
